CONNECTOR::disable
       Disable all the connectors on chain.

SYNOPSIS
       CONNECTOR::disable

DESCRIPTION
       Disable all the connectors  on chain

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    CONNECTOR::disable
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0 --First introduced the command.
